data.narrative:
Eden Geopower, a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Paris Smalls and Ammar Alali, has raised $19.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Climate & Energy comp universe of nine entities (one public, eight private), including peers such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the immediate peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow valuation tier for a median-based approach.

Consequently, stage-progression methodology was the applicable triangulation technique. Using total capital raised ($19.8M) as a proxy valuation anchor and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied value of $49.5M. This single-method result constrains the valuation range but limits cross-validation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M (low) to $57M (high), with a median point of $50M. The narrow methodological foundation reflects a fundamental constraint: Climate & Energy lacks sufficient close-stage, close-tier private comparables publicly available. Key uncertainties include actual post-Seed round pricing momentum within the sector, capital efficiency relative to the broader peer set, and whether Eden Geopower's technology or market positioning warrants premium or discount to stage-typical multiples. Additional data on near-term funding rounds or revenue metrics would sharpen this assessment materially.
